title: security(cloud-connection): the marketplace install-local resolver admits an API key without asking its owner's account posture, where ruling C′ refuses it at every seam
body:
Filing gate ①, class (b), under the security exception: `reach:` is a function-level source reading, with no route recipe on GitHub, per the lane's disclosure rule.

This card carries one seam of ruling C′ (#23287, `6159450584`) that PR #23440 does not reach; #23287 keeps the seven faces PR #23440 builds. It is a derived sub-issue of #23287, owned by that card's claim seat (`domain:spec#4`), priority inherited.

Blocked-by: #23287

Filed by `domain:spec` seat 4 (#18917) · `sunhaolin` · session `session_0121ooBYRmS8ziFXm9ai5YHm`, from the dev report `6165340573` on #23287 (out-of-scope finding 1), checked on `origin/main` `61b12584f0`. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What differs

`@objectstack/cloud-connection` `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`: the resolver behind its install-local doors calls `resolveAuthzContext` and asks `evaluateAuthGate` about the session user only. Once PR #23440 lands, this resolver still passes no `userAuthGates`. So an API key whose owner holds an `account`-scope posture (`MFA_REQUIRED`) is served there, while every face PR #23440 builds refuses the same key with `403 MFA_REQUIRED`.

## The contract

Ruling C′ item 1, quoted: "a held user's API key is refused at every seam with the same code".

`Seam: spec:AUTH_GATE_SCOPES → runtime:cloud-connection marketplace-install-local resolver | consumer: none`

## Reader who acts

`domain:spec` seat 4, the claim seat of #23287, dispatches it once PR #23440 is on `main`. The fix wires `userAuthGates: userAuthGateSourceOf(authService)` into that resolver and reads the resolver's `authGate`. Its pins follow PR #23440's three-fact shape: a held owner's key gets `403 MFA_REQUIRED` (`code` + `status`); a key whose owner holds only a credential-scope posture is served; the same key is served again once the posture clears.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repo, closed included: `cloud-connection marketplace install-local API key owner MFA posture authGate userAuthGates resolveAuthzContext` → 6 hits.
- #15353 (closed) is the same resolver's `tenancyPosture` arm: an ex-member's key, a different question.
- #15352, #15349, #15350 and #15351 (closed) are the other families' tenancy arm.
- #8355 (closed) is the README wiring example.

None is this.

Dedupe words: marketplace install-local API key posture; userAuthGates cloud-connection; held key install-local.
